usage.source_scope: 把功能部件作为 scene-graph 节点与关系，而非只保存物体类别。
usage.project_application: 为 L10 的 instance → functional part → interaction zone 建立显式可审计中间表示。
usage.modifications: 图中必须分别记录 public referent、功能部件和动作区；禁止把关系推断当作独立完成回执。
usage.expected_effect: 让错误可定位到 object binding、part grounding 或 interaction-zone 三个不同阶段。

evaluation.setup: 未执行；最小证伪实验：用同一批场景冻结 perception，比较 object-only graph 与 functional-part graph；主指标为逐阶段可判定率和错误层定位准确率。
evaluation.claim_boundary: 图结构改善可解释性不等于功能成功；未执行 BlindAssist 实验，不能推出开放世界覆盖、物理可达、用户收益或安全。

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.

history.change: Added from the user-provided directed literature review as a candidate only; no route authority or experimental result was created.
